source_title: Tilak Varma breaks world record during India vs New Zealand 2nd T20I - The Times of India
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: Tilak Varma created history on Saturday by becoming the fielder with the most catches in T20 Internationals in a calendar year.The Indian cricketer took two catches in the opening three overs of New Zealand's innings in the second T20I, dismissing Tim Seifert and Daryl Mitchell. With these catches, Tilak moved past Indonesia's Danilson Hawoe, who held the previous record with 25 catches in 2025.Tilak has now taken 26 catches as a fielder in T20Is in 2026, setting a new world record.Most catches as a fielder in T20Is in a calendar yearCatchesPlayerTeamYear26Tilak VarmaIndia202625Danilson HawoeIndonesia202524Muhammad WaseemUAE202421Sharvin MuniandyMalaysia202520Brian MasabaUganda202320Tanzid HasanBangladesh2025India make two changes for 2nd T20IIndia won the toss and elected to bowl against New Zealand in the second T20 International on Saturday.India made two changes to their playing XI.
